description: A hundred and eighty seats going down to a screen that fills the whole end wall, and a ceiling so far up in the dark that you take its height on trust. Six seats in row F have been reupholstered and the other hundred and seventy-four have not, so there is a small bright rectangle of newer red in the middle of all that brown. The organ sits in a pit below the screen on a lift that has not been raised in living memory, its console open, its stops out. It smells of dust warmed by lamps and, underneath, very faintly, of oranges.
name: Reel Estate — The Auditorium
